Added unit coverage for version bounds and MIME/wildcard cases.

+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> Set[str]:
+    """Return missing file suffixes for Qt's affected file picker versions."""
+    # WORKAROUND for Qt 6.2.3 through 6.6.x: MIME types passed to the file
+    # picker don't always expand to all of their associated extensions.
+    if (not qtutils.version_check("6.2.3", compiled=False) or
+            qtutils.version_check("6.7.0", compiled=False)):
+        return set()
+
+    accepted = set(upstream_mimetypes)
+    suffixes = set()
+    for mime in accepted:
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            prefix = mime[:-1]
+            suffixes.update(
+                suffix for suffix, mapped_mime in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mapped_mime.startswith(prefix)
+            )
+        elif "/" in mime:
+            suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+
+    return suffixes - accepted
+
+
 class WebEngineView(QWebEngineView):
 
     """Custom QWebEngineView subclass with qutebrowser-specific features."""

         accepted_mimetypes: Iterable[str],
     ) -> List[str]:
         """Override chooseFiles to (optionally) invoke custom file uploader."""
+        accepted_mimetypes = list(accepted_mimetypes)
+        accepted_mimetypes.extend(sorted(
+            extra_suffixes_workaround(accepted_mimetypes)
+        ))
         handler = config.val.fileselect.handler
         if handler == "default":
             return super().chooseFiles(mode, old_files, accepted_mimetypes)
diff --git a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
index 98bf34f..d127fc3 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
@@ -58,3 +58,56 @@ def test_enum_mappings(enum_type, naming, mapping):
     for name, val in members:
         mapped = mapping[val]
         assert camel_to_snake(naming, name) == mapped.name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("version, expected", [
+    ("6.2.2", set()),
+    ("6.2.3", {".jpg", ".jpe"}),
+    ("6.6.3", {".jpg", ".jpe"}),
+    ("6.7.0", set()),
+])
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_version(monkeypatch, version, expected):
+    from qutebrowser.utils import utils
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        webview.qtutils, "version_check",
+        lambda minimum, compiled: (
+            utils.VersionNumber.parse(version) >= utils.VersionNumber.parse(minimum)
+            if compiled is False else None
+        ),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        webview.mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+        lambda mime: [".jpg", ".jpe"],
+    )
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/jpeg"]) == expected
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_mime_and_suffixes(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.qtutils, "version_check",
+                        lambda minimum, compiled: minimum == "6.2.3")
+    extensions = {
+        "image/jpeg": [".jpg", ".jpe"],
+        "image/png": [".png"],
+        "video/mp4": [".m4v", ".mpg4"],
+    }
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+                        lambda mime: extensions[mime])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.mimetypes, "types_map", {
+        ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+        ".jpe": "image/jpeg",
+        ".png": "image/png",
+        ".mp4": "video/mp4",
+    })
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", "video/mp4"]
+    ) == {".jpg", ".jpe", ".m4v", ".mpg4"}
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", ".jpg", ".jpe"]
+    ) == set()
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround([".jpg"]) == set()
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/*", ".jpg"]
+    ) == {".jpe", ".png"}
